summary: JBDI Holdings, a Cayman-incorporated, Singapore-based metal drum manufacturer listed on Nasdaq, furnished this 6-K regarding a 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting to be held virtually on October 22, 2026. The EGM will consider four proposals: increasing authorized share capital; creating a dual-class structure of Class A and Class B shares with reclassification of existing Ordinary Shares as Class A; adopting a Second Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles; and issuing 7,000,000 Class B Ordinary Shares to EUG Investment Limited, the controlling shareholder. No special-situation terms, prices, or premiums are stated; watch governance dilution and voting-power shifts.
